title: Phir Teri Kahani Yaad Aayee
overview: Alcoholic movie director Rahul ends up in a rehabilitation centre. Once there, he meets Pooja, an inmate who is suicidal and has deep ranging mental problems. After an initial clash of personalities, the two become friends and lovers. But Pooja's paranoia and instabillity make any relationship impossible. As a result she is hospitalized in a mental institution. Shortly thereafter there is a fire at this institution, and Pooja is killed. Then Rahul starts getting phone calls from someone whose voice resembles Pooja's.
